card.name: Verbs and particles before an object
card.fires_on: Verbs or particles such as by, switch, with, on, to that come right before an expected object or complement. Mostly in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Particle after a verb
modes.description: A preposition or particle that follows a verb and leads into what is acted on, such as by, with, on, to.

modes.label: Action verb awaiting its object
modes.description: A transitive or phrasal verb that is still waiting for its object or complement.
modes.example: Both of those poor showings occurred following an FDP decision to<< switch>> coalition partners.

card.plain: It fires on small action words, like by or switch, that are about to be followed by the thing being acted on.
